profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its site presents Claude as its AI, described as built for problem solvers and aimed at complex challenges, data analysis, code writing, and difficult work. The company's tracked products include Claude, a general LLM assistant; Anthropic Console, an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls; Claude Code, described as agentic coding with source-code exposure; and Computer Use (Anthropic), a computer control agent for desktop automation that carries system access and high-privilege operation risk.

Anthropic is also listed in an MCP registry entry, ai.getvda/llm-orchestration-agent-langchain-anthropic, described as an LLM Orchestration Agent (Langchain Anthropic).

The company is named in a substantial set of court matters. These include Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC in the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit; University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court, D. Delaware; and cases in the District Court, N.D. California (Patel, Smith, Pascual, Shakespeare, and Kahn v. Anthropic, PBC), the District Court, D. Vermont (Brunell v. Anthropic PBC), the District Court, D. Hawaii (Gribble and Haugland v. Anthropic PBC), the District Court, D. Delaware (Haugland v. Anthropic PBC), and the District Court, E.D. Pennsylvania (GROSSINGER v. ANTHROPIC, PBC.). A separate count of legal exposure places 278 matters in California.
